message: feat(presentation): integrate Atelier catalog art and native-pixel hunting journeys
purpose: Preserve the tested dense hunting world and controls. Copy checksum-verified compatible Atelier assets as one complete humanoid rig cohort. Keep gameplay IDs and the independent Atelier gear ladder separate. Default to native-size world pixels and unstretched item icons. Add two connected beginner dungeons and correct over-level dungeon populations with saved-pet protection. Retain every existing test and add image-integrity, native layout, traversal and migration checks.
